QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] A Memory's Reflection
QuestInfo.0: Kao and Rino have returned from the Fountain of Reflection. Does that mean Kao's memories have returned?
QuestInfo.1: Kao's memories have been restored, but that does not seem to have raised the Temple Keeper's Spirits. What happened? Maybe Rino can tell you.
QuestInfo.2: Rino said that the only memories one can see in the fountain's waters are their own. Rino doesn't know what memories Kao saw, but she says they must not have been good ones...

0.msg: #bDid you find your memories at the Fountain of Reflection?#k

1.msg: I only saw pieces of my past in the fountain's waters... But, new memories are beginning to surface thanks to what I saw.

2.msg: I've accomplished what I set out do, but I should at least escort you to your destination.

3.msg: #b(It seems like Kao's memories are starting to come back, but the Temple Keeper still doesn't look happy. What happened? Maybe Rino knows.)#k

0.msg: #b(Rino must know something, since she was there with Kao at the fountain.)#k
#b(You're not really interested in what Kao's memories revealed.)#k

1.0: Kao didn't react well to what was in the fountain. Maybe they were bad memories?
1.1: The fountain's waters only show our own memories, not those of others. I'm afraid I have no idea what Kao saw.
1.2: Oh, did you get those Hard Shells?
1.3: Excellent, you have everything. This shell should do nicely. We're ready to call your Flame Bird. Just put the Hard Shell up to your lips and blow.

0.msg: #b(Rino must know something, since she accompanied Kao to Fountain of Reflection.)#k
